usedFor: Records created in Clientary, like “New Invoice”, send their text through “Humanize Text” in Hastewire.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in Clientary, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: It runs when an invoice is created, and the action rewrites text so it sounds natural.

watchOut: Every Clientary trigger here, including “New Payment”, is polling, so “Humanize Text” runs on a schedule.
